value.name: Daniel releases desk and stands
value.description: Daniel lets go of the desk edge, his knuckles whitening and then relaxing as he rises from his seat.
evidence: Daniel let go of the desk edge then, the white pressure leaving his knuckles in stages, and stood

value.name: Daniel composes himself
value.description: Daniel smooths the front of his jacket as if trying to carry the room with him.
evidence: smoothing the front of his jacket as if the gesture might carry the room with him

value.name: Daniel asks to leave documents
value.description: Daniel carefully tells Asha she can leave the documents on the desk and that he will return shortly.
evidence: He said, in a voice gone careful around its own evenness, that she could leave the documents on the desk, he would be back in a moment

value.name: Daniel exits without looking back
value.description: Daniel walks past Rosa to the doorway and leaves the room without turning his head.
evidence: and walked past Rosa to the doorway without turning his head

value.name: Asha lets Daniel go
value.description: Asha keeps her hand on the page and allows Daniel to leave.
evidence: Asha kept her hand where it was on the page and let him go

value.name: Objects remain undisturbed
value.description: The tray, cup, and folded papers remain exactly as they were, emphasizing the scene's stillness after Daniel leaves.
evidence: the tray on the side table, the cup Rosa had set down, and the unsmoothed half of the fold all stayed exactly where they were
